_comment: Hardware config for celere_pipeline.py. Peaks in TFLOPS, utilisations in 0..1, bandwidths in GB/s, frequency in Hz.
_comment_util: PE_utilization derates the PE path (non-GEMM everywhere, plus GEMMs on a pool with no tensor engine). TE_utilization derates GEMM_peak on pools that have one (TensorPool's RedMulE) and does not affect Terapool.
_comment_links: bandwidth_c2c_gbs is the on-chip cluster-to-cluster link. bandwidth_lpddr_gbs is PER CHANNEL; an off-chip leg is charged at bandwidth_lpddr_gbs * lpddr_channels capped by bandwidth_c2c_gbs, since the bytes still cross the on-chip network. With these values the cap binds.
_comment_clusters: Cross-check only: the sum of the stage widths in STAGES. The partition itself is in celere_pipeline.py, not here.
